_note: Trimmed structure of Claude Desktop's Code tab (instance eek, 2026-10-03). Tailwind utility class lists are shortened to the meaningful ones. No message text or chat titles. Rects are css px at 2782x1496 dpr 1 and are examples, not constants.

div.dframe-chrome-bar.draggable.note: absolute top-0 inset-x-0, h 36, pl 12, pr 137, gap 4, z 21

children: div[role=radiogroup][aria=Mode] 70x28 r7 bg white5% > button[role=radio][aria=Chat and Cowork] 34x26 r5, button[role=radio][aria=Code] 34x26 r5 (selected: bg white15%)
right group: button[aria=Terminal], button[aria=Changes], button[aria=Browser], button[aria=View options] each 26x26 r6
button.w-full[New] 269x26 r6 (shortcut kbd 'Ctrl + N' on hover)
button.w-full[Artifacts] + inline button[aria=New from a template] 20x20
button.df-user-menu-btn (avatar circle 'E', name, plan, chevron) h28

div[role=feed][aria=Chat messages].note: virtualized: rows are absolutely positioned; only rows near the viewport exist

children: div[role=article][aria=Message N].rounded-lg.focus-visible:shadow-focus > div.mx-auto (840 wide, --chat-gutter 32px, 16px under 560px container) > div 768 wide > turn
button[aria=Scroll to bottom] 36x36 absolute left-1/2 above the dock
approval cards render here (permission / question / plan), epitaxy-approval-inline-enter fade

nav[aria=Repository and pull request controls] > div.bg-alpha-1 (40px, r10, p8, gap5) > [project button, branch button, counts button, div[role=group][aria=Create PR] > button + button[aria=More PR options], button[aria=Dismiss]]
div.epitaxy-prompt > div > (div.bg-surface-3 box 40+ h, r12, p8) + (toolbar row 20px)

user.tree: div.group/message-row.ms-auto.flex.flex-col.items-end.gap-xs > [div.relative.flex.flex-col.rounded-[--cds-message-bubble-radius].px-[--cds-message-bubble-pad-x].py-[--cds-message-bubble-pad-y] (maxWidth 638, r10, p 8/12, bg white5%) > div.cds-user-message-body 14/18 ; div[role=toolbar][aria=Message actions] (time, Copy, Rewind to here, Fork from here)]

assistantText.tree: div.group/message-row.flex.w-full.flex-col.gap-xs > div.flex.flex-col.gap-5 (compact gap-4) > div.block > div.prose > p | ul | ol | h3 | pre | table ; then (last block of a turn) div[role=toolbar][aria=Message actions] (Copy, Fork from here, Pin as chapter, Read aloud, time)

prose.code: inline, mono 12.6px, #ec7e7e on white5%, border 1px white10%, r5

statusRow (tool group).tree: div.group/status[data-state=done|running].flex.flex-col.-my-pad-xs > div.flex.gap-xs.items-center.font-sans.text-body (h24, p 2px 4px, r6) > [span.group/phrases (label, morphing text span.group/morph), span.text-secondary summary + span[role=button] truncate hover:underline, button (12x20 chevron, rotates), span flex-1 spacer], span[role=status].sr-only
statusRow (tool group).expanded: NOT captured (expanding is not an allowed interaction)

transcriptTurnTypes.scrollToBottom: button[aria=Scroll to bottom] 36x36 absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2, glyph 20px mix-blend-luminosity

menus.common: role=menu (cds-reset draggable-none group/menu-popup flex flex-col min-w-128 max-w-320), r10, bg #20201f, ring inset white10%, shadow 0 8px 24px #00000052 + 0 2px 6px #0003; inner div.overflow-y-auto.scroll-fade-y.p-1 (4px)
menus.permissionMode: role=menu > div[role=group] > [div[role=presentation] header 'Mode' (px 8, py 4, 13px/500 muted), div[role=menuitemradio] x5 (flex, gap 6, px 8, 40.5px high, title span + description span.text-footnote.text-muted; right: kbd number or check icon)]; opens ABOVE the trigger, left-aligned to it, 278x234
menus.model: role=menu > [menuitemradio x4 (24px, label + kbd number / check), div[role=separator] (1px, inset 8), menuitem 'More models' + chevron-right]; 128 wide (min-width), opens above, right edge aligned to trigger
menus.effort: role=dialog (not menu): div.rounded-card (r22).bg-surface-3.shadow-panel.p-3 220 wide > [header row: h2 'Effort' muted + current name (font-medium, coloured) + button[aria=About effort]; labels row 'Faster' / 'Smarter' (13px muted); div[role=group].group/slider > track (h20 r6 bg white10%, fill white35%), 6 stop dots (3px, white25%) with the active stop a 3x9 pill, handle 16x20 white r6 with input[aria=Effort]; caption under the handle (13px muted)]
menus.plus: role=menu > menuitem x5 (24px each, icon 16 + label, shortcut kbd 'Ctrl + U' on the first, chevron-right on Connectors)
menus.sidebarMore: role=menu opens to the RIGHT of the More row (x 281, y aligned to the row), 128x66: menuitem 'Routines' (icon Clock), separator, menuitem 'Edit sidebar…'
